notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

uses.name: Weatherlight Compleated
uses.cardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it
